en: Black‑and‑white view of a grand, tree‑lined avenue flanked by richly ornamented late‑19th‑century buildings with mansard roofs and elaborate facades. The street is densely built, with hotel‑like structures bearing balconies and bay windows; in the background, larger villa‑style buildings rise on a wooded hillside. The overall feel is of a historic European spa or resort town. Visible signage on one of the buildings reads "EXCELSIOR" and "EXCELSIOR HOF."
